key_points: Barrons reports Target gaining market share as value-seeking shoppers switch from rivals
Target hires Hilton's marketing chief, strengthening brand and customer acquisition capability
Promotional deals rolling out to win back customers may drive traffic but pressure near-term margins
Supplier bankruptcy (Christmas retailer) poses minor supply chain risk but unlikely to materially disrupt Target
Costco's delivery expansion adds competitive pressure but Target's own fulfillment investments mitigate
